description: The main window loads the daemon's own remote page (http://127.0.0.1:<port>), never bundled content — so this capability grants that origin, and only that origin, the two commands the page needs to drive the desktop shell's autostart toggle. Nothing else is exposed: this shell holds no credential and makes no outbound request of its own (see src/main.rs), and IPC access must not become a second way to widen that.
